text:
Felix R: Quick brief  compact visual set for our webinar + nurture: hero diagram (deck + social crop), three square microtiles (throughput, tail latency, unit cost), and a single-page benchmark snapshot (anonymized + methodology note). Keep it email-first, mobile-friendly. Timeline: first pass by Mon 9am PT.

June H: Got it. Any preference on visual tone? Minimal / data-forward or illustrative? Also need copy and aspect ratios.

Felix R: Minimal + data-forward. Copy: Headline: 'Serving > Owning for predictable inference'. Tiles: Throughput, Tail latency, Unit cost. Ratios: hero 1200x628 (and 600x314 crop), tiles 1080x1080, bench 1280x720. GIF only for hero (3s, subtle).

OpsDesign: tagging @June H  we'll produce SVG masters + PNG exports. Requesting final copy file and any hero motion notes. We'll include an accessibility/high-contrast variant.

Felix R: Uploading copy & methodology doc now: https://drive.company/launch/mini-pack (anonymized metrics: ~35% unit reduction with caching+batches). Use phrasing like "~35% unit cost reduction" or "up to".

BrandBot: accessibility note: primary blue #1A6FE0 borderline at 12px captions. Recommend #0C47A0 for captions or 14px min. Add ALT text for every export. Include 8px logo padding and TM footer on bench snapshot. Also provide a color-blind safe variant.

June H: noted. We'll set caption text to 14px semi-bold and use #0C47A0 for small type. Deliverables: SVG masters, PNG 2x for socials, tiles at 3 sizes (1080, 720, 480), GIF 1200x628 3s loop. Include a README frame in Figma with filenames and export settings. ETA first pass: Mon 8:30am PT.

Kai L: Legal note: avoid guarantees. Aggregate phrasing ok. Please ensure the bench snapshot has a small TM/legal line in the footer and no customer names.

OpsDesign: We'll mock two hero approaches (A: flow highlighting cache/batch; B: compact comparative bars). Which should be GIF?

Felix R: Flow for GIF; bars for slide.

BrandBot: quick compliance checklist: 1) AA contrast at intended sizes, 2) ALT text present, 3) 8px logo safe area, 4) color-blind variant, 5) TM footer on bench.

June H: Adding an accessibility frame and alternate accessible palette. All text layers left editable for localization (EN -> ES/FR/JP). We'll tag frames: HERO_FLOW, HERO_BARS, TILE_THROUGHPUT, TILE_LATENCY, TILE_COST, BENCH_SNAPSHOT, README_EXPORTS.

Felix R: Awesome  Ill review copy once you drop first pass. Please tag me in figma comments with "Ready for review".

OpsDesign: Will upload first-pass and drop export zip in the drive. Ping here when ready. :sparkles:
